headline: Anthropic's IPO could exceed $1.5 trillion
summary: Anthropic is about to set its IPO share price above the initially planned level because of strong investor demand. The report says the offering underscores sustained market interest in artificial intelligence.
why: Anthropic is a San Francisco-based AI developer. Its IPO pricing is a key test of investor appetite for large AI companies.
original_headline: OPI de Anthropic superaría los 1.5 billones de dólares
